answer: Under Section 145 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (Chapter 6: OF OFFENCES AFFECTING THE HUMAN BODY), habitual dealing in slaves. Whoever habitually imports, exports, removes, buys, sells, traffics or deals in slaves shall be punished with imprisonment for life or imprisonment up to 10 years and fine.
